links.outcome: Errors and potential harm in AI-drafted hepatology e-consult responses rated by hepatologists
links.effect: 72% of drafts rated reasonable starting points; 83% had appropriate case-specific recommendations; 10% contained misleading/incorrect information; 3.4% posed risk of severe harm.
links.quote: Human reviewers rated 72% of drafts as reasonable starting points and 83% as providing appropriate case-specific recommendations; 10% contained misleading/incorrect information, and 3.4% posed a risk of severe harm.

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM-as-a-judge (OpenAI-o1) for rapid quality assurance of drafts during model updates, tested for equivalence with human reviewers

screen.reason: The study evaluates an LLM (LiVersa) drafting hepatology e-consults and assesses the safety/accuracy of its drafts using human specialist and LLM-as-a-judge review. While human oversight is noted as necessary, the study does not test an intervention/deployment practice with-and-without comparison.
